content.user_title: Build Apps on the Claude API and Anthropic SDKs
content.value_statement: Developers waste time guessing at Claude model ids, deprecated parameters, and SDK method names that drift between releases. This skill supplies verified, current reference material so your Claude integration code compiles and runs correctly the first time.
actual_capabilities: Provides exact, current Claude model ids and pricing so requests do not fail with 404 errors.
Documents SDK usage for Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, Ruby, C#, and PHP, plus raw cURL.
Explains adaptive thinking, the effort parameter, and other API changes that break older code.
Covers tool use, structured outputs, streaming, prompt caching, and token counting patterns.
Guides model migration with per-version breaking-change checklists and drop-in replacements.
Describes Managed Agents, MCP integration, and server-side tools with per-language examples.
limitations: It is a reference skill; it does not run code or make API calls on your behalf.
Cached model and pricing tables can lag behind new releases; live lookup is sometimes needed.
It targets Claude and the official Anthropic SDKs, not other model providers.
It does not manage your API keys, billing, or account configuration.

use_cases.description: A backend engineer adds a Claude call to a Python service and needs the right model id, parameters, and streaming pattern without trial and error.

use_cases.description: A team maintaining an older Claude integration follows a step-by-step checklist to swap the model id and remove deprecated parameters safely.

use_cases.description: A developer building an autonomous assistant chooses between tool use, Managed Agents, and MCP, then implements the loop correctly.

prompt_templates.prompt: Migrate my Claude integration to the newest Opus model, enable adaptive thinking, and add prompt caching for my large system prompt. Confirm scope before editing files.

output_examples.input: Which model id should I use for the most capable Claude model, and how do I set thinking?
output_examples.output: Use claude-opus-4-8 for the current top Opus model. Enable adaptive thinking by passing a thinking config with type set to adaptive. Do not pass a token budget, because that parameter is removed on recent models and returns an error.

output_examples.input: My Claude request fails with a 404. What is wrong?
output_examples.output: A 404 usually means the model id is invalid. Use an exact id from the reference, such as claude-opus-4-8 or claude-sonnet-4-6. Do not append a date suffix to an alias, because that produces an unknown model id.

best_practices: Use the exact model id strings from the reference and avoid appending date suffixes to aliases.
Enable adaptive thinking and set the effort parameter instead of using deprecated token budgets.
Stream any request with a large output limit to avoid connection timeouts.
anti_patterns: Do not guess SDK method or class names; verify them against the language-specific documentation.
Do not mix the raw HTTP client with the official SDK in the same project.
Do not truncate long input silently; discuss chunking or summarization with the user instead.

faq.question: Which Claude model should I use by default?
faq.answer: Use claude-opus-4-8 unless you explicitly need a different tier. Choose Sonnet for a balance of speed and cost, and Haiku for fast, simple tasks.

faq.question: Why does my request return a 404 error?
faq.answer: The model id is likely wrong. Use an exact id from the reference and do not add a date suffix to a model alias.

faq.question: How do I enable extended thinking on newer models?
faq.answer: Set the thinking type to adaptive and control depth with the effort parameter. The older fixed token budget is removed on recent models.

faq.question: Which programming languages are supported?
faq.answer: The skill covers Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, Ruby, C#, and PHP through the official SDKs, plus raw cURL for other languages.

faq.question: How do I stop my output from being cut off?
faq.answer: Raise the maximum output token limit and use streaming for large responses. Streaming avoids the timeouts that occur on very long non-streaming requests.

faq.question: How do I migrate to a newer Claude model safely?
faq.answer: Confirm which files to change, swap the model id, remove deprecated parameters, then run one test request. The skill provides a per-version breaking-change checklist.
